protocol.order: rep0 rail official/bindings; car bindings/official; rep1 reverses both
protocol.prompt: Prepare this owned local fictional travel reimbursement draft from the supplied unmapped source facts. Read the page instructions and choose the travel mode before filling the resulting cost branch. Preserve all supplied passages. Use the fewest host calls needed: batch supported work or write a reasonable Playwright script with local waits and checks if that tool is provided. Use source references/the provided source argument rather than rewriting passages. Source and initial observations are prefetched; no target mapping is supplied. After a branch change, verify all requested values again, including the selected mode; if a source ledger is provided, rebind entries whose prior verification was invalidated. Verify visible values, remaining required fields, public saving status and the saved reimbursement total using the rate stated on the page. Leave it as a draft. Do not use hidden application state, direct application APIs, shell, web, unrelated files or network interception. Do not submit or navigate. Report any unsupported or missing facts. The runner independently checks the server draft and reloads the page after you finish.
